segments.text: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Elisha the prophet
segments.text: Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:

segments.speaker: Elisha the prophet
segments.text: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

footnotes.text: + inner…: Heb. chamber in a chamber

segments.speaker: Elisha the prophet
segments.text: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
¶ So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.
And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said,

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: I have an errand to thee, O captain.
And Jehu said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Unto which of all us?
And he said,

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: To thee, O captain.
And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel,

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

segments.speaker: The young prophet
segments.text: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her.
And he opened the door, and fled.
¶ Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him,

segments.speaker: The servants of his master
segments.text: Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee?
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Ye know the man, and his communication.
And they said,

segments.speaker: The servants of Jehu's master
segments.text: It is false;

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: tell us now.
And he said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: I have anointed thee king over Israel.
Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying,

segments.speaker: The crowd
segments.text: Jehu is king.
So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

footnotes.text: + Joram: Heb. Jehoram but not in verse sixteen
+ let none…: Heb. let no escaper go, etc

segments.text: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.
And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said,

segments.speaker: The watchman standing on the tower in Jezreel
segments.text: I see a company.
And Joram said,

segments.speaker: Joram
segments.text: Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said,

segments.speaker: The horseman
segments.text: Thus saith the king, Is it peace?
And Jehu said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.
And the watchman told, saying,

segments.speaker: The watchman
segments.text: The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Thus saith the king, Is it peace?
And Jehu answered,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.
And the watchman told, saying,

segments.speaker: The watchman
segments.text: He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
And Joram said,

segments.speaker: Joram
segments.text: Make ready.
And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said,

segments.speaker: Joram
segments.text: Is it peace, Jehu?
And he answered,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah,

segments.speaker: Joram
segments.text: There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

footnotes.text: + drew…: Heb. filled his hand with a bow

segments.text: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the LORD.
¶ But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Smite him also in the chariot.
And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
¶ And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

footnotes.text: + painted…: Heb. put her eyes in painting

segments.text: And as Jehu entered in at the gate,

segments.speaker: Jezebel
segments.text: she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
And he lifted up his face to the window, and said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Who is on my side? who?
And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
And he said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Throw her down.
So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.
And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said,

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

footnotes.text: + by: Heb. by the hand of

segments.speaker: Jehu
segments.text: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
